note: The due list made to read what a judge reads (register decisions 392-397). Each mutant takes one narrowing or one widening away; the judges are the two self-tests, the real runs against this tree -- a lambert-shader change, which must list m1-18 and m1-19 and must not list m1-16 or m1-97 -- the must-fail runs, test_probe_sidecar for the sidecar's two new lines, and mutants_due_gpu_identity, which refuses a validated run without the layer (decision 398). The script mutants build nothing (decision 392). The C++ mutants build the application and are judged by mutants_due_probe_shaders, which requires probe_data, so CTest runs every probe with the mutated application first. Proposed survivors, declared: the call that asks for the graphics card's reason, the test of which files are judged on a card, and the harness skipping the build of a mutant that names none -- each reached only by a real pass or a real record, never by a test.
